title: Lascaris Support, yearly (USD)
description: Lascaris Support is a yearly support package from Scalytics for Lascaris, the open Streamhouse that runs Kafka on object storage you already own. It covers the Kafka on S3 platform plus an immutable backup for Confluent, Apache Kafka, Redpanda and Amazon MSK, in your environment. Brokers are stateless and your bucket holds the data, so there are no broker disks to buy and no partitions to rebalance. Agents, policy checks and a signed audit trail are built in. You can run it in your cloud or data center, including on-premise and air-gapped sites. The package includes a remote onboarding configuration review (2 hours), a DORA Article 12 and NIS2 Annex II evidence pack, a quarterly DR test runbook, updates and fixes for the supported release, and email support with a 2-business-day response. The software itself has no licence fee.
